name: Iceland
intro: Prices are in Icelandic krónur (ISK), with a switch to see them in pounds, euros or US dollars. Menu prices include VAT and service; tipping isn't expected. Prices checked October 2026.
serviceText: Every figure is for one guest. Icelandic menu prices include VAT and service, so there's nothing to add for food; tipping isn't expected. Prices shown in other currencies use the day's exchange rate and are approximate.
sourcesText: Dinner is the restaurant's tasting menu, and wine is its wine pairing. Prices come from each restaurant's own website where they're published, otherwise from recent reviews.
starsText: The Google reviews score out of 5 and the number of reviews, checked in October 2026. Stars come from the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Nordic Countries.
